The '''skirmish aboard the ''Nanda's Luck''''' took place when the [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] aboard the [[Majestic (pirate ship)|''Majestic'']] attacked the fishing vessel ''[[Nanda's Luck]]''.<ref name="Ando" />

The crew of ''Nanda's Luck'' put up a ferocious fight even though they were outnumbered easily by three to one. The fight ended when [[Pyash Yopayomba]], the leader of the pirates, joined the fray. A skilled fighter, she killed almost two dozen deckhands and defeated [[Sissalik]] in a duel that lasted ten seconds. After accepting the surrender of [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Bipopa Bogzider]], she killed him with her [[Vibroblade/Legends|vibroblade]] and appointed Sissalik as the new captain of the ''Nanda's Luck''.<ref name="Ando" />
